mechanism: Primaquine may cause hemolysis and hemolytic anemia, leading to altered glucose metabolism and reduced insulin requirements; additionally, primaquine's hepatic metabolism via CYP2D6 is independent of insulin but hemolysis-induced anemia can affect glucose homeostasis.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely during primaquine therapy and adjust insulin glargine dose as needed; assess for signs of hemolysis and anemia which may alter insulin sensitivity.
